import base64
from app import create_app, db
from app.models import Role, User, Post, Comment, Permission

app = create_app('testing')
with app.app_context():
    db.drop_all()
    db.create_all()
    Role.insert_roles()

    u = User(email='john@example.com', username='john', confirmed=True)
    u.password = 'cat'
    db.session.add(u)
    db.session.commit()

    assert u.verify_password('cat')
    token = u.generate_auth_token(3600)
    assert User.verify_auth_token(token).id == u.id

    client = app.test_client()
    resp = client.get('/')
    print('index', resp.status_code, 'Stranger' in resp.get_data(as_text=True))

    login = client.post('/auth/login', data={
        'email': 'john@example.com',
        'password': 'cat',
        'remember_me': 'y'
    }, follow_redirects=True)
    print('login', login.status_code, 'Hello, john"'!'"' in login.get_data(as_text=True))

    post_resp = client.post('/', data={'body': 'Hello **world**', 'category': 'python'}, follow_redirects=True)
    print('new post', post_resp.status_code)

    post = Post.query.first()
    assert post is not None
    post_page = client.get('/post/%d' % post.id)
    print('post page', post_page.status_code)

    comment_resp = client.post('/post/%d' % post.id, data={'body': 'Nice post'}, follow_redirects=True)
    print('comment', comment_resp.status_code)

    creds = base64.b64encode(b'john@example.com:cat').decode('utf-8')
    api_user = client.get('/api/v1/users/%d' % u.id, headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds})
    print('api user', api_user.status_code, api_user.json.get('username'))

    api_post = client.post('/api/v1/posts/', json={'body': 'API post', 'category': 'api'}, headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds})
    print('api post', api_post.status_code)

    token_resp = client.post('/api/v1/tokens/', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds})
    print('token', token_resp.status_code, 'token' in token_resp.get_json())
PY"
